newsitem.title: USA: U.S. airlines trim spring and summer fares.
newsitem.headline: U.S. airlines trim spring and summer fares.

text.p: Several U.S. airlines slashed some spring and summer fares, following a similar move by American Airlines on Sunday.

AMR Corp's American Airlines said it cut fares up to 50 percent on most domestic routes for travel through May 5 and up to 45 percent savings through September 6. Sale fares are also available for Mexico, Latin America and the Caribbean.
Continental Airlines Inc and US Airways Group Inc on Monday announced similar fares cuts.

Vanguard Airlines Inc said it will offer a 50 percent discount on all childrens fares for travel completed by October 1. Vanguard also said it continued its spring fare promotion, offering price cuts to its 15 destinations.
